title: ProReviewer: Evidence-Driven Investigation for Scientific Peer Review
abstract: arXiv:2606.13349v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Effective peer review requires adaptive investigation that responds to evidence emerging from each paper. Existing LLM-based reviewers largely organize the review process around predefined workflows, leaving limited scope for emerging evidence to reshape investigation. We propose ProReviewer, an evidence-driven review agent that formulates reviewing as a Markov Decision Process, with a structured review log forming the core of its state. At each step, the agent uses accumulated findings to decide what to inspect next and when to conclude. As new evidence emerges, it updates the log by revising claim statuses, resolving open questions, and recording new findings. Each point in the final review cites supporting log entries, making its judgments traceable to the recorded evidence. On 1,000 held-out ICLR 2026 papers, the trained 8B ProReviewer achieves the highest average score among all compared methods, including those built on a 397B

translated_title: ProReviewer：面向科学同行评审的证据驱动式调查
translated_abstract: 有效的同行评审需要能够响应每篇论文中新出现证据的自适应式调查。现有的基于大语言模型的评审系统大多围绕预定义的工作流来组织评审过程，使得新出现的证据难以重塑调查方向。我们提出了ProReviewer，一个证据驱动的评审智能体，它将评审过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并以结构化的评审日志作为其状态的核心。在每一步中，智能体利用已积累的发现来决定接下来检查什么以及何时结束评审。随着新证据的出现，它通过修订论断状态、解决未决问题和记录新发现来更新日志。最终评审中的每个要点都引用了支持性的日志条目，使其判断可以追溯至所记录的证据。在1000篇留出的ICLR 2026论文上，经过训练的8B ProReviewer在所有对比方法中取得了最高的平均分数，包括那些基于397B模型构建的方法。
tldr: ProReviewer将科学同行评审建模为马尔可夫决策过程，通过结构化评审日志动态追踪、更新和追溯证据，实现了证据驱动的自适应评审，在ICLR 2026论文上以8B参数规模超越包括397B模型在内的所有对比方法。
en_tdlr: ProReviewer formulates scientific peer review as a Markov Decision Process with a structured review log, enabling evidence-driven, traceable and adaptive investigation that achieves the highest average score among all compared methods—including those built on a 397B model—on 1,000 held-out ICLR 2026 papers.
